headline: Indian Instagram has fallen for AI-made animals reciting Urdu poetry, led by a dog poet named Rita Bhonkni.
score_reason: Lively viral trend described in an opinion column, with no audience figures.
importance_line: Indian Instagram users are following an entirely synthetic soap opera with rivalries and fake deaths, a sign of how quickly AI entertainment builds a fandom; the column gives no view counts, so the scale is unmeasured.
summary: ThePrint reports that AI-generated videos of a cat hosting a mushaira, a traditional Urdu poetry gathering, where a dog poet called Rita Bhonkni trades verses with a snake rival named Nagina Dasni, have become the latest craze on Indian Instagram, complete with a fake death announcement, polls and fan debates. The columnist admires the costumes but concludes it "is still AI slop", however much poetry it is wrapped in.
